EntityProps.Name: COMPANY
EntityProps.Comment:
Name: Company
Definition: A COMPANY is a legally constructed organization that is created for the purpose of conducting legitimate business.
Examples: 1) Aera Energy 2) LLC, 3) Schlumberger 4) McJunkin 5) TekSystems 6) SENA 7) SENAC 8) SIEP 9) SCL 10) SOI 11) SWEPI 12) Group Companies
Behavior Rules: 1) A COMPANY is a legal entity registered with a Registrar of Companies. 2) Used in a general sense, may also include unincorporated joint ventures. 3) The smallest Shell organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting (e.g. Profit/Loss and Balance Sheet reports are generated off the Company Code).
Other Business Names:
Source: AERA
Change Log: 7/12/2012 - Added additional examples.

EntityProps.Name: CONTACT_MECHANISM
EntityProps.Comment: The full specification of a means of contacting something or someone. Examples are: A fully-specified street address (i.e. Street Number, Street Name, City, State, & Zip Code), a fully-specified phone number (e.g. area code, prefix, suffix, & extension), a fax number, mobile phone number, pager number, email address. Note: for our business purposes it has been decided that all contact mechanisms are attributive to the associated entity. In other words, there is no business need to manage the mechanisms themselves, separately from the entity that they are used to contact.

EntityProps.Name: CONTACT_MECHANISM_ROLE
EntityProps.Comment: Identifies the roles the contact mechanism plays. A particular contact mechanism may play 0, 1 or many roles. Example: If Joe has an address of 100 Main Street, that address can play the role of his 'shipping address' and his 'remit to address'. He, however, may have a second address, 59 West Street, that plays the role of 'correspondence mailing address'.

EntityProps.Name: FACILITY
EntityProps.Comment: A capability to perform a business function or a service. It is a token or a concept used to describe the functional capability that may arise from the installation of Equipment and Materials. Facilities do not have mass, they are not physical objects. Only the Equipment or Materials that are installed to provide the service are physical objects. The actual equipment or materials that are installed at a Facility can change over time, and can be any type of equipment or materials that carry out the same business function. Facilities enable business functions to be described independently of the equipment or materials that may be installed from time to time.

EntityProps.Comment: The specific value of a PARAMETER TYPE for a particular FACILITY. For example, the "Capacity" of a Steam Generator might be "3,000" (UNIT OF MEASURE: CWE (cold water equivalent) barrels of steam per day). This describes a relatively static characteristic of a FACILITY (i.e., the nature of the facility). The data which describe a FACILITY's ongoing, dynamic, operational characteristics are contained in DYNAMIC PARAMETER VALUE.

EntityProps.Name: FIELD
EntityProps.Comment: An area identified by the enterprise where oil or gas is, or has been, commercially extracted. (EDAM 2013.1: –An area consisting of a single reservoir or multiple reservoirs all grouped on or related to the same individual geological structural feature and/or stratigraphic condition. There may be two or more reservoirs in a field which are separated vertically by intervening impervious strata, or laterally by local geologic barriers, or by both. Reservoirs that are associated by being in overlapping or adjacent fields may be treated as a single or common operational field. The geological terms "structural feature" and "stratigraphic condition" are intended to identify localized geological features as opposed to the broader terms of basins, trends, provinces, plays, areas-of-interest, etc.)

EntityProps.Name: ITEM_SPECIFICATION
EntityProps.Comment: The actual VALUE of one Parameter Type (i.e. characteristic) of a specified Item at a specified point in time. For Example: To specify the Parameter "horsepower" of a specific ITEM -- a Gould 3160 Centrigugal Horizontal Overhung Pump, mfr serial number #123456000 -- we would find that given ITEM and the given PARAMETER TYPE (horsepower) associated with an ITEM SPECIFICATION, in which we would find the "Value" of, for example, "45" (hp). Expressed in a sentence: "A 45 [ITEM SPECIFICATION] horsepower [PARAMETER TYPE] Gould 3160 [ITEM, mfr ser #123456000]."

EntityProps.Name: PROJECT
EntityProps.Comment:
A grouping of Work Activities and associated information that constitutes a plan for accomplishing a goal. A project consists of Lower Level Work Activities and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Elements. A project cannot be nested within another project, projects are grouped via Programmes.
Note: A project may exist to build a facility or to group activities by the function, or group, responsible for executing the work on an ongoing basis (as in the case of a Completions & Well Intervention Functional Activity Plan for IAP)

EntityProps.Comment: The carrying out of Work. It may be as high-level as a program or as detailed as a task. A Work Activity requires inputs (resources, e.g. persons, rigs, cement) and produces an output (e.g. a facility, a well, a drawing, a weld). It tracks usage and consumption of resources involved in the work. It may fulfill a work request or work order. Activities exist to carry out / build / upgrade / fix / maintain / order / measure / test, etc. Work Activities may be grouped together across Projects or WBS Elements to ensure optimum resource useage or to minimze the impact of the work (for example, in the case of a maintenance campagn, aligning shutdown windows to minimize deferment, leveling the use of shared resources to minimize cost, etc).
